description: Check progress of an in-flight bulk job created by `bulk_whois` or `bulk_email_verification`. Returns `running` or `completed` plus progress counters. Use this when a bulk call returned a `job_id` instead of inline results — poll until completed, then call `bulk_job_results`. Do NOT use this for emulated bulk tools (`bulk_dns_lookup`, `bulk_subdomain_lookup`, `bulk_ip_geolocation`); they always return inline.

job_id.description: Opaque job identifier returned by a bulk_* tool when status=running.

name: bulk_job_status
